PR: fix: Add beta trace for namespaced resources [closed]
### Description of your changes

It is reported that beta trace is not following the composed resources. This PR fix that issue and also support tracing claims based composed resources.

Fixes https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/issues/6365

In this PR, I have added the support for tracing the composed resources created with claim as well as namespaced XRs.

However, it is not the complete fix as we can see in that output that pod SYNCED and STATUS are not available. I think this could be handle separately.

As, in V2 proposal Crossplane can compose any kubernetes resource, trace command should show valid status for all those resources.

└─ Pod/my-pod (crossplane) - True
